description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Reliability Score" and "Cost" for three different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20. The plot contains three solid lines, each marked with solid circular data points at x=0, x=5, and x=10. The blue line, representing the "3-Model Ensemble," shows a slight, steady decline, starting at a Reliability Score of approximately 83 at a Cost of 0, passing through approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and ending at approximately 75 at a Cost of 10. The red line, representing the "2-Model Ensemble," exhibits a steady decline, beginning at approximately 85 at a Cost of 0, intersecting the blue line at approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and concluding at approximately 73 at a Cost of 10. The yellow line, corresponding to a blurred legend entry, demonstrates the steepest steady decline, starting at an initial Reliability Score of approximately 89 at a Cost of 0, dropping to approximately 65 at a Cost of 5, and finishing at approximately 41 at a Cost of 10.
